Day 7 - SHRIMP ARE HERE

April 28, 2026

Got some crystal red shrimp I paid with cash so it doesn’t count also went to petco and got shrimp food and a small net and baster I thought they...

Got some crystal red shrimp I paid with cash so it doesn’t count also went to petco and got shrimp food and a small net and baster I thought they were Neocaridina but not. Also around 40% water change. Higher nitrates but no nitrates or ammonia. Drip acclimated shrimp with baster over course of a couple hours. Around 2:20 am, the shrimp went in. They went to work immediately, scuttling on leaves and tearing off bits of algae. I could see the biggest one noticeable pic up dirt particles and chew One medium sized one that pauses a bit more than others.
